In the academic session of 2004–2005, the Central Government granted permission to expand the intake capacity to 100 students, reflecting the college’s growth and commitment to providing quality dental education. At Santosh Dental College , students gain a comprehensive understanding of the biological and physical processes of oral health. The curriculum is designed to equip them with the essential skills needed for the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of oral diseases, fostering a deep sense of responsibility toward improving dental and oral health in society. The college is closely associated with a well-equipped dental hospital that offers specialized care in various dental disciplines, giving students practical exposure to real-world clinical environments. The college offers a BDS program with a sanctioned intake of 100 students and an MDS program with 27 seats annually, both approved by the Dental Council of India. Additionally, the Ph.D. program is recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC), further enhancing the academic offerings. With a continuous commitment to advancing education and providing state-of-the-art facilities, Santosh Dental College ensures that students receive not only academic instruction but also a well-rounded, hands-on learning experience. We believe that a truly comprehensive education empowers students to become self-sufficient, skilled professionals in the field of dentistry. Dean's Message Welcome to the College of Dentistry, where learning, innovation, and transformation converge. For decades, we have been a leading institution in dental education, oral health research, and patient care, recognized as one of the nation’s foremost centers for excellence in the field. Our vision is to advance the practice of dentistry by inspiring leadership and driving innovation in education, research, and clinical care. We are deeply committed to shaping the future of healthcare by equipping students at the undergraduate, postgraduate, and Ph.D. levels with the skills and knowledge they need for professional success. At our institute, we have made significant strides in modernizing our departments with state-of-the-art technology. From Endodontic Microscopes and CBCT Aligners to Conscious Sedation Units and Intraoral Scanners, our cutting-edge facilities enhance both academic and clinical training. Our 900-bedded hospital for trauma and surgical cases further enriches students' practical learning experiences, ensuring they are prepared to meet the evolving demands of the dental profession. We foster a culture of respect, continuous learning, and the free exchange of ideas, creating an environment where innovation can flourish. As you embark on your journey with us, you will be part of a community that is dedicated to excellence and driven by a shared commitment to advancing dental care. Established in 1995, the college has consistently provided high-quality education and training in medicine, striving to produce skilled medical professionals dedicated to serving humanity. Innovative Teaching, Learning and Evaluation Process at Santosh Deemed to be University Santosh Deemed to be University emphasizes on innovative teaching methods and inter-disciplinary focus. Its teaching methodology includes: Organ based teaching method Delivery of inter-disciplinary programs leveraging strengths across schools – for example, Forensic Odontology Innovation – Stem Cell banking Research carried out by students in emerging areas like chord blood banking, cryopreservation of RBC and tissue engineering Apart from adopting innovative teaching methods, Santosh Deemed to be University has also developed an innovative curriculum. It uses a blend of classroom, practical and community engagement to promote holistic learning. Established in 1995, the college has consistently provided high-quality education and training in medicine, striving to produce skilled medical professionals dedicated to serving humanity. Over the years, Santosh Medical College has earned a prominent position among the top medical colleges in India. The college offers a range of well-recognized courses, including the undergraduate MBBS program, along with postgraduate degrees in MD, MS in 22 disciplines and doctoral (PhD) courses across 17 medical disciplines. In the academic session of 2004–2005, the Central Government granted permission to expand the intake capacity to 100 students, reflecting the college’s growth and commitment to providing quality dental education. At Santosh Dental College , students gain a comprehensive understanding of the biological and physical processes of oral health. The curriculum is designed to equip them with the essential skills needed for the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of oral diseases, fostering a deep sense of responsibility toward improving dental and oral health in society. The college is closely associated with a well-equipped dental hospital that offers specialized care in various dental disciplines, giving students practical exposure to real-world clinical environments. The college offers a BDS program with a sanctioned intake of 100 students and an MDS program with 27 seats annually, both approved by the Dental Council of India. Additionally, the Ph.D. program is recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC), further enhancing the academic offerings. With a continuous commitment to advancing education and providing state-of-the-art facilities, Santosh Dental College ensures that students receive not only academic instruction but also a well-rounded, hands-on learning experience. We believe that a truly comprehensive education empowers students to become self-sufficient, skilled professionals in the field of dentistry. Dean's Message Welcome to the College of Dentistry, where learning, innovation, and transformation converge. For decades, we have been a leading institution in dental education, oral health research, and patient care, recognized as one of the nation’s foremost centers for excellence in the field. Our vision is to advance the practice of dentistry by inspiring leadership and driving innovation in education, research, and clinical care. We are deeply committed to shaping the future of healthcare by equipping students at the undergraduate, postgraduate, and Ph.D. levels with the skills and knowledge they need for professional success. At our institute, we have made significant strides in modernizing our departments with state-of-the-art technology. From Endodontic Microscopes and CBCT Aligners to Conscious Sedation Units and Intraoral Scanners, our cutting-edge facilities enhance both academic and clinical training. Our 900-bedded hospital for trauma and surgical cases further enriches students' practical learning experiences, ensuring they are prepared to meet the evolving demands of the dental profession. We foster a culture of respect, continuous learning, and the free exchange of ideas, creating an environment where innovation can flourish. As you embark on your journey with us, you will be part of a community that is dedicated to excellence and driven by a shared commitment to advancing dental care.  for r in rows[:60]: print(r)
